main_text.l: sciplinæ magister, ille quæ à Sancyrano
hauserat, vulgata Theologorum Schola-
sticorum placita de attritione vix ferre
poterat, & ob id inprimis apud Richeli-
um male audiit; quia tunc temporis quid-
am Jesuita, qui erat à Confessione Re-
gis Christianissimi, hanc doctrinam de
necessitate contritionis contra vulgus
Theologorum & communem societatis
suæ sententiam Regi suggerebat, & quia
Rex erat ingenio morofo ac difficili, re-
bus tractandis postea minus commo-
dum illum expertus est Richelius. Ita-
qve Segvenoti de attritione sententia à
Theologis Parisiensibus autore Cardinale
Richelio damnata est, at in Jesuitæ illi-
us rigidioris ac minus humani locum, a-
lius Jesuita humanior ac mollior audiendæ
Regis Confessioni succederet.
In-
terim Morinus Richelio atqve inprimis
Celloto & Rabardeo Jesuitis, qui de Se-
gvenoto palam in libris suis detraxerant,
infensissimus nuncium sedis Apostolicæ
una cum Bertado ejusdem Congregationis
Oratorii Theologo invisit, & grega

page.notes: The first word is a fragment at the page start: the initial letter is cut off, so it is printed "sciplinæ", not "disciplinæ". "Itaqve" is partly uncertain in its last letters (printed with a curled q). The catchword "lera" at the lower right is only partly legible and may be a fragment of the next word. The word "grega" ends the page without a visible hyphen.
